title: Clinical and laboratory-based prognostic factors for pediatric postthrombotic syndrome: findings from the Kids-Duration of Therapy for Thrombosis in Children trial.
publicationName: Research and practice in thrombosis and haemostasis
journalName: Research and practice in thrombosis and haemostasis
snippet: Knowledge on risk factors for the development of pediatric postthrombotic syndrome (PTS) is scarce. We previously identified low plasma fibrinolytic capacity and persistent complete veno-occlusion as candidate risk factors for pediatric PTS.
